The dollar just hit its strongest level in 19 months.
Early Thursday (Nov 12, 2026), the dollar index hit 103.02, the highest since April 2025 (Reuters).
The driver: traders betting the Fed raises rates in December after hot October inflation.
One dollar bought almost 160 yen, versus a 131 average in 2022 (Fed data). Our math: $1,000 is about ¥160K now vs ¥131K then.
Wins: trips abroad, some imports. Loses: US companies selling overseas. Japan reminded traders it stepped in this summer.
Sources: Reuters, Federal Reserve G.5A.
News and education, not financial advice.
